label.zh: 解锁步枪弹药和霰弹枪弹药配方
label.en: Unlock rifle and shotgun ammunition recipes

help.zh: 原版要先给武器工作台装上“步枪钻孔工具”，Demo 里不一定拿得到。打开后，下次打开工作台时解锁；解锁记在存档里，再关掉不会收回。
help.en: The game unlocks these with the Rifle Boring Tools augment, which the Demo may not offer. When on, they unlock the next time you open a workbench. The unlock is saved and turning this off does not undo it.
